We need DBE for C12H6O2. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (ignoring O, S, halogens). No N. So DBE = 12 - 6/2 + 1 = 12 -3 +1 =10. So integer 10.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we already know. But to follow process, maybe call retrieve_dbe_formula to show formula. Not required but okay. Let's call tool.
